workflow.name: Cisco Intersight - Remove VLAN from VLAN policy
workflow.title: Cisco Intersight - Remove VLAN from VLAN policy

properties.description: Deletes one exact fabric.Vlan from one exact fabric.EthNetworkPolicy. Confirm Removal defaults false and must be true. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read organization/fabric resources and delete fabric.Vlan. It validates VLAN ID 1-4093, protects VLAN 1, resolves exact ownership/cardinality, shows the policy/VLAN Name/ID/Moid summary, and revalidates it before DELETE. OpenAPI documents only HTTP 200 with no content as success: non-200 is failure, missing status is ambiguous, and unexpected 200 content is inconsistent success without retry. A second run handles not-found and issues no DELETE. GET and DELETE are not transactional, so concurrent writers can change state; validate behavior in a non-production tenant. Generic APIs are used until a supported atomic exists.
properties.display_name: Cisco Intersight - Remove VLAN from VLAN policy

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
preparationStatusCode = "500"
preparationMessage = "VLAN removal input preparation did not complete."
preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error":preparationMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
preparationToken = ""
normalizedOrganizationName = ""
normalizedPolicyName = ""
escapedOrganizationName = ""
escapedPolicyName = ""
normalizedVlanId = 0
confirmationAccepted = ""
NAME = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$")

try:
    organizationName = str(sys.argv[1]).strip()
    policyName = str(sys.argv[2]).strip()
    vlanIdText = str(sys.argv[3]).strip()
    confirmText = str(sys.argv[4]).strip().lower()
    errors = []
    if not NAME.fullmatch(organizationName):
        errors.append("Policy Organization must contain 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")
    if not NAME.fullmatch(policyName):
        errors.append("VLAN Policy Name must contain 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")
    try:
        if not re.fullmatch(r"-?[0-9]+", vlanIdText):
            raise ValueError()
        vlanId = int(vlanIdText)
    except Exception:
        vlanId = 0
        errors.append("VLAN ID must be an integer.")
    if not (1 <= vlanId <= 4093):
        errors.append("VLAN ID must be from 1 through 4093.")
    if vlanId == 1:
        errors.append("VLAN ID 1 is protected and cannot be removed by this workflow.")
    if confirmText in ("true","1"):
        confirmed = True
    elif confirmText in ("false","0"):
        confirmed = False
        errors.append("Confirm Removal must be true before any target lookup.")
    else:
        confirmed = False
        errors.append("Confirm Removal must be a boolean value and must be true.")

    if errors:
        preparationStatus = "invalid"
        preparationStatusCode = "400"
        preparationMessage = " ".join(errors)
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Input validation failed","details":errors}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        normalizedOrganizationName = organizationName
        normalizedPolicyName = policyName
        escapedOrganizationName = organizationName.replace("'","''")
        escapedPolicyName = policyName.replace("'","''")
        normalizedVlanId = vlanId
        confirmationAccepted = "true"
        preparationToken = json.dumps({"Organization":organizationName,"PolicyName":policyName,"VlanId":vlanId,"ConfirmRemoval":True}, separators=(",",":"))
        preparationStatus = "ready"
        preparationStatusCode = "200"
        preparationMessage = "Organization, policy, VLAN ID, VLAN 1 protection, confirmation, and OData fields are valid."
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"validated":True,"VlanId":vlanId,"ConfirmRemoval":True}, separators=(",",":"))
except Exception as exc:
    preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
    preparationStatusCode = "500"
    preparationMessage = "VLAN removal input preparation failed: " + str(exc)
    preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"VLAN removal input preparation failed","details":preparationMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
    preparationToken = ""
